name.value: Kitimat Visitor Centre & Chamber of Commerce

description.value: The Kitimat Chamber of Commerce & Visitor Centre has been connecting local businesses and welcoming visitors since 1955. Housed within is the Coastline Collective Gift Store, featuring handmade goods and souvenirs from over 20 local artisans alongside maps, brochures, and community information. It is a natural first stop for touring cyclists arriving in Kitimat who want local knowledge, regional brochures, and a taste of the community's creative economy.
